scope: Core PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, and Directus health-probe failures

behavior.health_result: Each probe preserves its existing generic unhealthy result and message.
behavior.server_log: Each caught failure logs only the bounded exception class, without exception text or traceback.

coverage: PostgreSQL failure is class-only in logs and remains unhealthy
ClickHouse failure is class-only in logs and remains unhealthy
Directus failure is class-only in logs and remains unhealthy
existing driver-registry health behavior remains covered

limitations: No live service endpoint or database was contacted.
No health status or readiness policy changed.
